info.name: FAOSTAT Bulk Download Catalog Dimensions API
Get dimensions available for a domain

params.name: lang
params.description: Response language code (en=English, es=Spanish, fr=French, ar=Arabic, zh=Chinese, ru=Russian)

params.name: domain
params.description: FAOSTAT domain code (e.g. QCL for Crops and livestock products, TM for Trade, RL for Land Use)

items.docs: Returns all available filter dimensions (area, item, element, year, flag) for a specific FAOSTAT domain.

info.name: Get members of a specific dimension

params.name: lang
params.description: Response language code (en=English, es=Spanish, fr=French, ar=Arabic, zh=Chinese, ru=Russian)

params.name: domain
params.description: FAOSTAT domain code (e.g. QCL for Crops and livestock products, TM for Trade, RL for Land Use)

params.name: dimension
params.description: Dimension name (area, item, element, year, flag)

params.name: output_type
params.description: Response format: objects (default, JSON array of objects) or arrays (JSON array of arrays) or csv (CSV text)

items.docs: Returns all valid members (codes and labels) for a given dimension within a FAOSTAT domain. Use dimension codes: area, item, element, year, flag.

params.name: lang
params.description: Response language code (en=English, es=Spanish, fr=French, ar=Arabic, zh=Chinese, ru=Russian)

items.docs: Returns all areas (countries, territories, and regional aggregates) available in FAOSTAT with their codes and names.

info.name: Get details for a specific area

params.name: lang
params.description: Response language code (en=English, es=Spanish, fr=French, ar=Arabic, zh=Chinese, ru=Russian)

items.docs: Returns detailed information for a specific area including its full name, ISO codes, and regional membership.
